title: Good Photo for an Anime Portrait: Before-and-After Guide
metaTitle: Good Photo for an Anime Portrait: Before & After Tips
description: Learn what makes a good photo for an anime portrait, from lighting and clarity to poses, selfies, framing, and reference photos for hand-drawn transformations.
intro: A good photo for an anime portrait gives a human artist the visual information needed to preserve your recognizable features while reimagining you as an original character. In the before-and-after process, the reference image provides your face shape, hairstyle, expression, clothing details, and pose; the finished artwork translates those details into a fan-art inspired visual language. At Anime Cabinet, every custom anime portrait is hand-drawn by a human artist rather than produced with an AI filter. You can choose from 24 anime and cartoon styles, receive a preview within 72 hours, and request unlimited free revisions before approving the final artwork. The goal is not to impersonate a copyrighted character, but to create a unique version of you inspired by the style you love.

blocks.text: **Can an artist create an anime portrait from an old or low-quality photo?** Often, yes, if the subject remains recognizable. Send the original file and any additional references you have, and explain which details matter most.
**What makes a good photo for an anime portrait?** Clear focus, soft lighting, visible facial features, a natural pose, and minimal filters make the reference easier to interpret.

**Can I order a custom anime portrait from photo as a gift?** Yes. You can provide photos and notes about the recipient’s personality, favorite colors, preferred style, and desired composition. The preview and revision process helps refine the result before approval.
